fields.name: Requested
fields.evidence: Windows bg3.exe+0x127C520 (= NoesisGameUI.dll gui::mod::RequestSystem::AddRequestedMods; component via storage index DAT_14631f268, stride 0x60) clears the set at +0 (buckets memset to -1, sizes +0x1C/+0x2C zeroed) and inserts every 8-byte key of its first map argument with bg3.exe+0x721030. Adder bg3.exe+0x127EF30 allocates 0x60 and zeroes two HashSets; destructor bg3.exe+0x6C6A10 destroys +0x30 and +0 with trivial keys.

fields.name: UpdateRequested
fields.evidence: Same Windows function clears the set at +0x30 (key count +0x5C, NextIds size +0x4C) and inserts every 8-byte key of its second map argument (HashMap<unsigned __int64, gui::mod::RequestSystem::UpdateRequest> in the NoesisGameUI.dll version); it runs when either set's key count or either map is non-empty.

summary: Client mod browser: ids of mods with pending requests from gui::mod::RequestSystem - downloads/info requests and update requests. Singleton, empty in all samples (idle).
open_questions: Which requests exactly feed the first set (download vs item-info): the maps are locals of RequestSystem::Update.
second_pass: Windows bg3.exe+0x127C520 (reached through the storage index DAT_14631f268) clears and refills both sets with 8-byte keys via bg3.exe+0x721030, confirming the two HashSet<uint64_t> at +0 and +0x30.
